description: Current USD price of one or more cryptocurrencies (ETH price, BTC price, any token by symbol or contract address), source DefiLlama. Parameter: ?coins=ethereum,bitcoin (comma-separated CoinGecko IDs, or 'chain:address' for a specific token, e.g. ethereum:0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7). Costs $0.005 via x402 (USDC).

coins.description: Comma-separated list of identifiers (e.g. ethereum,bitcoin or base:0x...).

name: get_api_defi_price
